observations.behavior: Adds a new constant _CHDB_SUBPROCESS_PROXY_ENV_VARS with uppercase HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY, and a comment explaining that deployment uses uppercase while chdb reads lowercase, and that without a lowercase copy, chdb connects directly and its reads skip the proxy's address checks.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent ClickHouse (chdb) from connecting through an egress proxy, potentially exposing it to untrusted hosts or bypassing network controls.

observations.behavior: Adds a dictionary comprehension to the subprocess environment, converting uppercase proxy variable names to lowercase and including their values if present in os.environ.
observations.code_quote: **{name.lower(): os.environ[name] for name in _CHDB_SUBPROCESS_PROXY_ENV_VARS if name in os.environ},
